newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - Walker wants to coach Wellington again.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - Walker wants to coach Wellington again.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Oct 17 - Frank Walker has decided to stand for a third season as Wellington rugby coach, NZPA reported on Thursday.
Walker was uncertain about his future after Wellington's loss to Otago last weekend which cost them the chance of their first appearance in the NPC first division semifinals.
The Wellington Rugby Football Union intends advertising the coaching job within and outside the capital, and Walker may have to be interviewed with other applicants.
He said Wellington might have to consider appointing both back and forward coaches.
"It's an idea which could be looked at," Walker said.
"There seems to be a trend in most professional sports, particularly in the United States, to appoint specialists.
"You don't always have the time you need to spend with both backs and forwards."
